incident_summary: After the durable Stage8 attempt marker, two concurrent workers advanced from the same marker without a post-marker execution lock. One worker performed the correct fail-closed static audit and persisted the create-only INVALID_EXECUTION primary result because the merged Stage4 implementation lacked the complete preregistered Stage8 execution interface. Independently, worker B had already downloaded the previously staged GitHub Actions artifact and, before discovering that concurrent PRIMARY_RESULT persistence, opened all 402 authorized staged historical payload objects exactly once and invoked one local ad-hoc scientific calculation harness. That harness was not part of the frozen Stage4 implementation and its local outcome is scientifically inadmissible. When worker B attempted create-only PRIMARY_RESULT persistence, GitHub rejected the create because the concurrent immutable PRIMARY_RESULT already existed. No overwrite was attempted.

governance_resolution.reason: The attempt is already consumed and the execution path diverged after marker; the frozen implementation was incomplete and a non-frozen concurrent harness was invoked. Both conditions invalidate scientific inference. The only legal action is incident-aware sealing and immutable closeout; no scientific rescue is permitted.
